title: Getting started with React hooks
content:
Hooks let function components keep state and run side effects.

Start with useState for values that change, and useEffect for work that must happen after a render.
author: Umesh Suwal

title: Designing accessible forms
content:
Every field needs a visible label, and every error needs to be announced.

Link an input to its error message with aria-describedby and mark it with aria-invalid.
author: Umesh Suwal

title: Server components in practice
content:
Server components load data directly and send no component JavaScript to the browser.

Keep 'use client' on the smallest leaf that needs interactivity.
author: Umesh Suwal
